tagline: We cook burger, pasta and cold coffee in Pune. No hard sell; ask anything you like.
about: Small questions are welcome too. We cook cold coffee, pizza and burger in Pune.
You will find us in Pune. Let us know the day and how many are coming.

features.title: Pizza
features.text: A thin, stretchy base with tomato, cheese and toppings of your choice. Curious about pizza? Ask, and we will talk you through it.

features.title: Burger
features.text: Burger is on the menu; ask what pairs well with it.

features.title: Pasta
features.text: Spaghetti, penne or filled shapes, tossed in a sauce that suits them. If pasta is why you came, let us know when you book.

features.title: Cold Coffee
features.text: Let us know what you need from cold coffee and we'll suggest where to start.

highlights.title: Local and personal
highlights.text: Run by people you can talk to.

steps.title: Get in touch
steps.text: Send a message or call and tell us what you need.

steps.title: Order from the menu
steps.text: Choose, share, or let us suggest.

faq.q: Do I need to book a table?
faq.a: Tell us when you plan to come and we'll say what's possible.
Find us in Pune. Send us a message and we will send directions.
Of course; feel free to ask us what goes into it and how to order it.
Yes; use the contact information on this page and we'll reply.
